offence_note: Robbery of elderly couple; four fraud and forgery offences
sentence_quote: Justice Davison sentenced him to five years imprisonment for the robbery offence and two years for each of the four offences, described above, to which he had pled guilty.
note: Five years robbery plus consecutive two years for concurrent fraud counts; total seven.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery, unlawful confinement, masked, breach of recognizance
co_offenders: Christie: 9 years, less 953 days credit; 18 months concurrent for breach
sentence_quote: The sentence of this Court in relation to Mr. Christie is nine (9) years. In the case of Mr. Halsey it is eight (8) years.
note: Delayed parole request refused; five years concurrent on confinement and mask counts.

sentence_quote: we would impose a global sentence of 10 years taking account of his pre-trial custody
note: Appeal allowed on error in principle; offences not named; 10 years global includes pre-trial custody.

offence_note: Theft under; failing to appear; breach of conditional sentence
sentence_quote: varied the 21 month unexpired part of the conditional sentence order by ordering the appellant to serve 12 months (8 months on the theft charge and 4 months on the failure to appear charge) in prison and 9 months to be served conditionally in the community.
note: Appeal on constitutionality of s. 742.6 breach procedure dismissed; variation of conditional sentence upheld.

sentence_quote: On 12 January 2000, Judge Smith sentenced the appellant to two years less a day, followed by four months' probation, to be served concurrent to any outstanding sentences.
note: Gladue considered and rejected by trial judge; Indigenous status not stated expressly.

offence_note: Sexual assault, unlawful confinement, assault, uttering threats
sentence_quote: I am sentencing you on Count 4, which is the sexual assault count, to a period of three years less time served which leaves an outstanding sentence of 595 days, by my calculation.
systemic_quote: particularly the effects of intergenerational trauma which I accept is operating in this case to reduce the moral culpability of C.A.J. for these offences
note: Victim surcharge waived; SOIRA 20 years; other counts concurrent.

offence_note: Sexual assault of underage girl; attempting to procure for prostitution
sentence_quote: the appellant was sentenced on the five counts to five years and two months in prison and made subject to an order under s. 161 of the Criminal Code
note: Joint submission; s. 161 order reissued with wording change only.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I would impose a sentence of five years incarceration, as suggested by the Crown on appeal.
note: Crown appeal allowed; 3.5 years raised to 5 years; firearms ban and DNA order remain.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery, use of imitation firearm, break and enter
sentence_quote: He received seven and a half years broken down as follows: four and half years for the robbery, four and half years concurrent for the break and enter, three years consecutive for use of the imitation firearm.
note: Consecutive to four years already being served for bank robbery, not included in total.

sentence_quote: grant Mr. Mander pre-sentence credit of 24 months thereby reducing his imposed sentence of 20 months to 12 months.
note: Pre-sentence credit raised from 1:1 to 1.5:1 per Summers; 3 years unchanged.

offence_note: Two thefts, breach of probation by possessing break-in tools, obstruction
sentence_quote: Eighteen months on Counts 1 and Count 7; six months on each of Counts 3 and 4, all of which will run concurrently.
note: Initially said 12 months, corrected to 18 months with 12 months credit; probation includes weapons and tools bans.
